findings.evidence: .github/workflows/explorer.yml:67-72 relies on configure-pages without enablement to reject any source other than GitHub Actions. However, the pinned action's findOrCreatePagesSite returns any existing Pages site without checking build_type; its main function then succeeds. See [pinned API client](https://github.com/actions/configure-pages/blob/45bfe0192ca1faeb007ade9deae92b16b8254a0d/src/api-client.js#L35-L70) and [entrypoint](https://github.com/actions/configure-pages/blob/45bfe0192ca1faeb007ade9deae92b16b8254a0d/src/index.js#L9-L19). The workflow proceeds directly to deployment without validating the source. This leaves the explicit rejection required by openspec/changes/publish-platform-explorer/specs/explorer-publication/spec.md:30-32 unenforced and contradicts the documented behavior.
findings.summary: The workflow does not enforce the required failure when Pages uses a branch-based source.
